messages.text:
<!here> Hi team,

As promised, <https://caliberinc.slack.com/docs/T01E0D9F1NW/F0AF7TNK3HP|here's our dog-friendly office policy> (which will live in the _Benefits at a Glance_ doc in the _policies-benefits_ channels on Slack).

Our intention is to create space for well-behaved dogs in the office in a way that’s thoughtful, safe, and workable, so please take a moment to read it.

This is not a free-for-all. We’re putting clear guidelines in place around behaviour, vaccinations, supervision, designated areas, and shared spaces to make sure this works for _everyone,_ not just the dogs and their owners.

Most important - your comfort matters. If you have allergies, concerns or feedback about this change, please reach out. We want to get this right, and we’ll adjust as needed. The goal is a policy that works for the whole team.

We appreciate everyone’s flexibility as we try this out.
